description: This file defines a Flutter widget called FavoritesScreen, which displays a grid of favorite recipes using provider for state management. It presents a list of favorited recipes retrieved from FavoritesProvider and RecipeProvider, and navigates to a detailed recipe screen when a recipe is tapped.

classes.name: FavoritesScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays the user's favorite recipes in a grid layout.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the FavoritesScreen, including an AppBar and a grid of favorite recipes or a loading indicator.
